sql_catalog:
SELECT omnichannel_payment_intent.payment_intent_id, omnichannel_payment_intent.business_type, omnichannel_payment_intent.business_id, omnichannel_payment_intent.payer_id, omnichannel_payment_intent.payee_id, omnichannel_payment_intent.operation, omnichannel_payment_intent.amount_minor, omnichannel_payment_intent.currency, omnichannel_payment_intent.channel_priority_json, omnichannel_payment_intent.selected_channel, omnichannel_payment_intent.state, omnichannel_payment_intent.idempotency_key, omnichannel_payment_intent.automatic_fallback_allowed, omnichannel_payment_intent.user_channel_consent_at, omnichannel_payment_intent.created_at, omnichannel_payment_intent.updated_at 
FROM omnichannel_payment_intent 
WHERE omnichannel_payment_intent.payment_intent_id = %(payment_intent_id_1)s::VARCHAR FOR UPDATE

SELECT omnichannel_money_movement.money_movement_id, omnichannel_money_movement.root_payment_intent_id, omnichannel_money_movement.parent_movement_id, omnichannel_money_movement.movement_type, omnichannel_money_movement.business_type, omnichannel_money_movement.business_id, omnichannel_money_movement.amount_minor, omnichannel_money_movement.currency, omnichannel_money_movement.state, omnichannel_money_movement.idempotency_key, omnichannel_money_movement.external_reference, omnichannel_money_movement.evidence_json, omnichannel_money_movement.created_at, omnichannel_money_movement.updated_at 
FROM omnichannel_money_movement 
WHERE omnichannel_money_movement.idempotency_key = %(idempotency_key_1)s::VARCHAR FOR UPDATE

SELECT catalog_credit_source.capture_id, catalog_credit_source.credit_id, catalog_credit_source.payment_intent_id, catalog_credit_source.funded_minor, catalog_credit_source.prior_refund_minor, catalog_credit_source.excluded_minor 
FROM catalog_credit_source 
WHERE catalog_credit_source.payment_intent_id = %(payment_intent_id_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT omnichannel_money_movement.money_movement_id, omnichannel_money_movement.root_payment_intent_id, omnichannel_money_movement.parent_movement_id, omnichannel_money_movement.movement_type, omnichannel_money_movement.business_type, omnichannel_money_movement.business_id, omnichannel_money_movement.amount_minor, omnichannel_money_movement.currency, omnichannel_money_movement.state, omnichannel_money_movement.idempotency_key, omnichannel_money_movement.external_reference, omnichannel_money_movement.evidence_json, omnichannel_money_movement.created_at, omnichannel_money_movement.updated_at 
FROM omnichannel_money_movement 
WHERE omnichannel_money_movement.root_payment_intent_id = %(root_payment_intent_id_1)s::VARCHAR FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO omnichannel_money_movement (money_movement_id, root_payment_intent_id, parent_movement_id, movement_type, business_type, business_id, amount_minor, currency, state, idempotency_key, external_reference, evidence_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (%(money_movement_id)s::VARCHAR, %(root_payment_intent_id)s::VARCHAR, %(parent_movement_id)s::VARCHAR, %(movement_type)s::VARCHAR, %(business_type)s::VARCHAR, %(business_id)s::VARCHAR, %(amount_minor)s::BIGINT, %(currency)s::VARCHAR, %(state)s::VARCHAR, %(idempotency_key)s::VARCHAR, %(external_reference)s::VARCHAR, %(evidence_json)s::JSON, %(created_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, %(updated_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)

SELECT order_supplier_fulfillment.order_supplier_fulfillment_id, order_supplier_fulfillment.payment_intent_id, order_supplier_fulfillment.business_type, order_supplier_fulfillment.business_id, order_supplier_fulfillment.supplier_id, order_supplier_fulfillment.supplier_idempotency_key, order_supplier_fulfillment.state, order_supplier_fulfillment.external_operation_id, order_supplier_fulfillment.supplier_confirmation_reference, order_supplier_fulfillment.evidence_reference, order_supplier_fulfillment.created_at, order_supplier_fulfillment.updated_at 
FROM order_supplier_fulfillment 
WHERE order_supplier_fulfillment.payment_intent_id = %(payment_intent_id_1)s::VARCHAR FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO omnichannel_ledger_entry (ledger_entry_id, transaction_id, payment_intent_id, account_code, direction, amount_minor, currency, entry_type, evidence_hash, created_at) VALUES (%(ledger_entry_id)s::VARCHAR, %(transaction_id)s::VARCHAR, %(payment_intent_id)s::VARCHAR, %(account_code)s::VARCHAR, %(direction)s::VARCHAR, %(amount_minor)s::BIGINT, %(currency)s::VARCHAR, %(entry_type)s::VARCHAR, %(evidence_hash)s::VARCHAR, %(created_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)

INSERT INTO order_supplier_fulfillment_event (order_supplier_fulfillment_event_id, order_supplier_fulfillment_id, event_type, state, evidence_reference, payload_hash, occurred_at) VALUES (%(order_supplier_fulfillment_event_id)s::VARCHAR, %(order_supplier_fulfillment_id)s::VARCHAR, %(event_type)s::VARCHAR, %(state)s::VARCHAR, %(evidence_reference)s::VARCHAR, %(payload_hash)s::VARCHAR, %(occurred_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)

UPDATE order_supplier_fulfillment SET state=%(state)s::VARCHAR, updated_at=%(updated_at)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE WHERE order_supplier_fulfillment.order_supplier_fulfillment_id = %(order_supplier_fulfillment_order_supplier_fulfillment_id)s::VARCHAR
